name: cli-commands
body: CLI commands: init [path] [--local], init-library <path>, config get|set|unset|list, start (`--port`, `--no-open`), check (`--all`, `--json`), render [slide] (`-o`, `--full`/`--fragment`), templates [name], upgrade, version (also `--version`/`-v`, printing `kalide <version>` from the build-stamped `main.version`, passed into `cli.Run`), and help; exit codes and terminal output, including the printed server URL. `check` validates and `render` writes slide HTML without serving: both exit 0 on success, 1 on a validation error and 2 on a usage error, with their command-specific presentation on solution.component.cli-check and solution.component.cli-render (the `templates` command on solution.component.cli-templates, `config` on solution.component.config-command). Shutdown: clean on SIGINT/SIGTERM (macOS) and Ctrl+C / Ctrl+Break (Windows, via os/signal `os.Interrupt`). A clean exit means exit code 0, the port released, and every child process reaped. init and init-library also write the author-guide pair (`AGENTS_KALIDE.md` full guide plus its `AGENTS.md` pointer; agent-authoring, agent-guide-reference, library-agent-guide, library-guide-layout) and their created-paths messages list the files written.
